title: Nested admissible affine charts for a smooth pair
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be smooth separated morphisms of pure relative dimensions $d,e\geq0$ between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and put $h=gf$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms].

For each $x\in X$ there are affine open neighbourhoods $S\subset Z$ of $gf(x)$, $V\subset g^{-1}S$ of $f(x)$, and $U\subset f^{-1}V$ of $x$, and etale maps [def-weil-etale-morphism]
$$v:V\to\mathbf A^e_S,\qquad u:U\to\mathbf A^d_V,$$
such that $g|_V=p_{e,S}v$ and $f|_U=p_{d,V}u$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. With $b:\mathbf A^d_V\to\mathbf A^d_{\mathbf A^e_S}$ the base change of $v$, both $b$ and $bu$ are etale, and
$$h|_U=p_{d+e,S}bu$$
under the ordered coordinate identification $\mathbf A^d_{\mathbf A^e_S}\simeq\mathbf A^{d+e}_S$ with the $f$ coordinates first. The schemes $S,V,U$ and all the indicated affine spaces are separated finite-type Noetherian $k$-schemes; all the displayed chart maps are separated and of finite presentation. These charts cover $X$, including the empty cover if $X$ is empty, and the assertion permits either or both of $d,e$ to be zero.

proof.text: Apply the local normal form Smooth.exists_etale_to_affineSpace (proved adopted-source theorem Smooth.exists_etale_to_affineSpace, which applies [lem-sc-standard-smooth-local-relative-dimension, lem-sc-standard-smooth-etale-polynomial-chart] and the affine-space spectrum description) to g at f(x). Restrict f to the inverse image of its affine source chart V; its relative dimension d persists by [lem-sbc-smooth-relative-dimension-permanence]. Apply the same local normal form to this restriction at x. Its source is an affine open of the open subscheme f-inverse(V); identify its image U as an affine open of X using the open-immersion isomorphism onto its image [def-weil-open-immersion]. Compose the second chart with AffineSpace.map of its affine target inclusion W into V, an open immersion by the affine-space Cartesian square [def-sbc-affine-space]. This gives an etale map to affine d-space over the original V. Cancel the monomorphism V into Y to verify its restricted projection equation. No characteristic or coefficient hypothesis is needed.

Construct the ordered affine-space isomorphism directly with AffineSpace.homOfVector [def-sbc-affine-space]. Its forward coordinates concatenate the outer d coordinates and the pullbacks of the inner e coordinates using Fin.addCases; its inverse takes the first and last blocks. AffineSpace.hom_ext and homOfVector_appTop_coord show both composites are identities and give the displayed coordinate and projection equations. The same formulas permit either block to be empty.

AffineSpace.isPullback_map identifies the base-change square [def-sbc-affine-space, def-pc-fibre-product]. Etaleness of the base-change map and its composite with u follow from [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change, lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation]. Rewrite the ordered isomorphism projection equation, AffineSpace.map_over, and the two chart equations to obtain the composite factorization.

The original schemes are locally Noetherian by finite type over the field [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]. Their affine opens inherit local Noetherianity [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-open-subscheme-noetherian]. All indicated affine-space projections are locally of finite presentation and quasi-compact; their finite-type structure maps imply local Noetherianity, and affineness supplies compactness. This proves Noetherianity and the three structural morphism properties separately for each of the seven listed Over objects. Composition uses [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence, lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change]; separatedness of affine sources uses [lem-weil-pbc-affine-source-morphism-separated].

For each of the seventeen chart arrows, affineness of its source supplies separatedness, and compact affine source with quasi-separated target supplies quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness [lem-weil-pbc-affine-source-morphism-separated, lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence]. Etale maps, isomorphisms, affine-space projections, and open immersions are locally of finite presentation; the two resLE arrows are composites of the etale charts and projections by their established equations. Thus composition [lem-weil-pbc-proper-fp-permanence] proves every listed arrow admissible. The entire construction is pointwise, so empty X is vacuous.
